relevance.rationale: Defines the ring of effective periods and states the Kontsevich-Zagier Period Conjecture governing why transcendence of weight-2 hyperbolic 3-manifold volumes (including Vol(4_1)) remains open after Archimedean evaluation.

keyResults.locator: §1.1-1.2 (Definition of periods and Conjecture 1); §2-3 (dilogarithm and L-value periods)
keyResults.statement: Conjectures all algebraic relations among periods arise from additivity, change of variables, and Stokes's formula, under which non-zero hyperbolic knot volumes are transcendental.
keyResults.useForFolio: Frames the exact claim boundary between proved formal-jet transcendence of Li_2(z) over Q[z] and open specialized-number transcendence of Vol(4_1).
